title: helenium nuttallii var. incisum
intro: Helenium nuttallii var. incisum, commonly known as Incised Sneezeweed, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Incised Sneezeweed are primarily attributed to its ability to reduce fever, relieve respiratory issues, and soothe digestive problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties are thought to be sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
